_what_this_is: Protected memory for defect classes the factory has already learned. Active entries are merge preconditions, not documentation.
The factory may propose a new lesson, but changing this registry changes the judge and therefore requires human-reviewed trust-root work.

Each assertion is evaluated against the exact current repository by harness/immunity.py. Equivalent refactors that remove an assertion require updating this protected registry rather than silently forgetting the lesson.

entries.lesson: The canonical E2E journey must remain in harness/ci.py and emit positive counted evidence.
